bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
mountpoint -q /mnt/g
test -d /mnt/g/GserverStorage
git fetch --no-tags origin bae258edb27dbd0351aad4914ec44bc28ef8bb99
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = bae258edb27dbd0351aad4914ec44bc28ef8bb99
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,tempfile,sys
old="74f012f6074ae513190946d470cbb104961ce037";new="bae258edb27dbd0351aad4914ec44bc28ef8bb99"
p=Path("scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py")
if p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file():
 raise RuntimeError("STAGED_RUNNER_ABSENT")
old_bytes=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{old}:scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py"])
if p.read_bytes()!=old_bytes:
 raise RuntimeError("STAGED_RUNNER_DIFFERS_FROM_LAST_PREFLIGHT")
new_bytes=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{new}:scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py"])
compile(new_bytes.decode(),str(p),"exec")
fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".all-activation-",dir=str(p.parent))
try:
 with os.fdopen(fd,"wb") as stream:stream.write(new_bytes)
 os.chmod(tmp,0o644)
 os.replace(tmp,p)
finally:
 if os.path.exists(tmp):os.unlink(tmp)
all_path=Path("scripts/userbot_public_video_archive_all.py")
assert all_path.is_file() and not all_path.is_symlink()
assert all_path.read_bytes()==subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{new}:scripts/userbot_public_video_archive_all.py"])
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path("scripts").resolve()))
from userbot_public_video_activate_all import compose_updates
updates=compose_updates(new)
print("ALL_CHANNEL_PREPARE=PASS")
print("PAGINATION_PATCH_FILES="+",".join(path.name for path in updates))
PY
if systemctl --user list-units --all --no-legend 'gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service' | grep -q gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114;then echo ALL_CHANNEL_JOB_EXISTS;exit 77;fi
systemd-run --user --collect --unit=gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114 --working-directory="$PWD" /usr/bin/python3 -u scripts/userbot_public_video_activate_all.py --source-commit bae258edb27dbd0351aad4914ec44bc28ef8bb99
echo ALL_CHANNEL_JOB_SUBMITTED=YES
systemctl --user show gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result --no-pager
echo ONE_RESIDENT_SESSION_PRESERVED=YES
